note: THE TWO COMPILE-TIME MACROS, AND THE MEASUREMENT THAT SURPRISED U.0: they behave IDENTICALLY in an interpreter. Emacs answers (3 6 '(1 2) '(1 2)) -- each evaluates its body at MACROEXPANSION time and expands to the value QUOTED, which is the same definition for both; they part company only inside a byte-compiler, which kg does not have. U.0 correction 4.7 is the other half: INERT versions do not reproduce the Phase 28 census column, because they carry four packages past a `require' those packages should have stopped at.
